sentences.en: America is a large country and its people are mobile.
sentences.zh: 美国是个大国，人民流动性很强。

sentences.en: Please don't look at your mobile phone while we're eating.
sentences.zh: 吃饭的时候请不要看手机。

sentences.en: My plan covers unlimited calls to landlines, but not mobiles.
sentences.zh: 我的套餐包含无限拨打固定电话的服务，但不包括手机。

senses.zh: 可移动的；行动自如的；易变的
